_comment: Intervention types Patrick OS can select between. A mechanism is WHAT gets
sold or delivered; it is not the same as the stage of work, and it is not the
same as which model runs the step.
This registry exists so that no code has to know that a website rebuild is a
possible outcome. Site Factory is the executor for exactly one row here.
Adding a non-website intervention is an edit to this file, not to Python.
status: 'available'  an executor exists and has been run
'declared'   the mechanism is real but nothing here executes it yet
'blocked'    an executor exists but is gated (see the project record)
preconditions are machine-readable [field, op, value] clauses evaluated by
patrick_os/selection.py against a structured profile extracted from a
diagnosis. The MODEL extracts the profile; the CODE decides. If the model
chose the mechanism it would choose the one it knows how to execute, which
is precisely the failure this stage exists to prevent.

website.label: Web-based intervention
website.description: Rebuilds, landing pages, and fixes to a site's structure or copy.
evidence_required: the page was actually retrieved (fetch_status ok)
identity verified to at least medium confidence
an observable defect a person can point at
website._note: Site Factory is the EXECUTOR for this mechanism, not the decision engine that chooses it. Status blocked is about the GATES, not the code: 10 of 12 teardown findings were re-verified fixed on 2026-09-03, and the two still live were repaired on branch fix/site-factory-correctness. Gate 1 and Gate 2 remain NO-GO because SF-10 leaves the benchmark irreproducible, so no measured quality claim is available. See projects/site-factory.md.
website._preconditions_why: SF-03 and SF-05 as preconditions rather than prose: no retrieved page means nothing is known about the site, and identity below medium means the defects may belong to a stranger. buyer_identified is SF-12.

positioning.label: Positioning and claim repair
positioning.description: Separating supported claims from aspirations and contradictions, and recommending what to preserve, eliminate, reposition, or test. The Narrative Decision Audit is this mechanism at the audit tier.
evidence_required: the claims the business currently makes, quoted
positioning._note: Per Patrick's own positioning note this is the cash engine's repeatable offer, and it is not a website intervention. narrative-decision-audit is its executor at the audit tier -- the sellable artifact. The DIAGNOSIS it rests on comes from narrative-diagnosis, which is deliberately mechanism-AGNOSTIC and therefore not listed here: a diagnosis that presumed positioning would be selecting the mechanism, which is the next stage's job.
positioning._preconditions_why: A positioning intervention needs an actual contradiction between what is claimed and what the evidence supports. Without one there is nothing to reposition, only opinions about tone.

messaging.label: Outbound messaging and sequence repair
messaging.description: The messages themselves: what is claimed, what is cited, what is asked for.
messaging._preconditions_why: Repairing messages requires a measured baseline. Rewriting outbound with no response-rate to compare against produces a different guess, not an improvement.

pricing.label: Pricing and packaging
pricing.description: What is charged, for what unit, at what commitment.
evidence_required: what was actually paid, not quoted
pricing._preconditions_why: Requires an observed pricing problem and someone with the authority to change a price.

ops-automation.label: Operational automation
ops-automation.description: Removing a repeated manual step. Patrick OS is itself an instance of this mechanism.
evidence_required: the repeated step, observed more than once
ops-automation._preconditions_why: Two observations in the same domain, because one repeated step observed once is an anecdote. Patrick OS is itself an instance of this mechanism.

none.label: No intervention supported
none.description: The diagnosis does not support selling anything yet. A first-class outcome, not a failure to decide.
none._note: Mechanism selection must be able to conclude this, or it is not selection. Site Factory had no way to express it: SF-03 turned a crawler timeout into a qualified rebuild opportunity at score 90.
none._preconditions_why: No preconditions. Always available, always last.
